entries.title: Steelrising
entries.definitive_edition: Steelrising Bastille Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Cagliostro's Secrets installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with full DLC route.

primary.version: Bastille Edition / base game plus Cagliostro's Secrets
primary.why: The Windows PC Bastille Edition route is the best version because it keeps native PC fidelity/capture flexibility while covering the important paid content: Cagliostro's Secrets, plus the edition/DLC extras such as the Discus Chain and cosmetic packs. The PS5 and Xbox Series X|S releases also support the same core game and DLC, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented over the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Steelrising Bastille Edition on Windows PC, or buy the base game plus Cagliostro's Secrets and DLC items separately. Play until after the Bastille level to access the Cagliostro's Secrets expansion content.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later remaster is documented; install Cagliostro's Secrets for the major post-launch quest content.
